durationMs.reveal: Completion squash lasts 200ms and the check fills. The mobile sheet may travel 8px.

hover.effect: Lift the control with translateY(-2px). Do not delay the feedback.
hover.reducedMotion: No translation. Show the enabled state with colour, icon, and text only.

press.effect: Move translateY(2px) and shrink the clay shadow. No bounce.
press.reducedMotion: No translation or shadow animation. Keep the pressed state in colour and text.

reveal.effect: The tile settles with a 200ms squash and the check fills.
reveal.reducedMotion: Skip the squash. Show the completed word, icon, and colour immediately.

image.effect: Clay images stay still. Do not zoom, parallax, or crossfade them in.
image.reducedMotion: Images are already static. No zoom, translation, or stagger.

menu.effect: The clay sheet slides down 8px. Links are operable immediately.
menu.reducedMotion: Fade only. Do not slide. Focus still moves and returns.

global.contentBeforeEnhancement: Visible, usable, and in reading order.
global.colorTransition: Colour, icon, and text carry state when motion is reduced. A loading spinner does not spin.
